Name: Ahimoth
Summary: Son of Elkanah, named among the sons of Elkanah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:25: Son of Elkanah, named among the sons of Elkanah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ahimoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
